body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Bella Vita Unit B304 Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 3 Beds 4 Sleeps 8 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views - Walking distance from the beach - Overlooks 350 feet of private deeded beach - 2 dedicated parking spots - 2 Gulf front pools - Gated community - Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Bella Vita Unit B304 sleeps 8 in an elegant 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom condo with breathtaking views of the Gulf from Blue Mountain Beach’s highest elevation point. Renowned for its views, Bella Vita’s gated community boasts 2 Gulf-front pools and private beach access. Arched doorways, a muted color palette, hardwood floors, and floor-to-ceiling views greet guests. The open kitchen has double ovens, premium appliances, and an island with seating for 4. A wet bar is brilliantly positioned between the kitchen and the living area, enabling guests to fix a cocktail or use the wine chiller before stepping through the sliding glass doors onto the balcony for sunset. Tucked behind the living area is a dining table with seating for 6 and entry to the 3 bedrooms. A primary bedroom has a king bed, built-in bookshelves, and floor-to-ceiling views from the sliding glass doors that open onto a private balcony. The spacious private bathroom has a soaking tub, separate shower, and beautiful artwork. A guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A second guest bedroom offers guests 2 queen beds and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Guests will appreciate the convenience of 2 Gulf-front pools, dedicated beach access, and the ability to walk to restaurants and shops in Blue Mountain Beach. Book a breathtaking Blue Mountain Beach vacation in Unit B304 today!
